answer_1.quote: We evaluate PEMA across two downstream tasks: the WMT22 EN→DE machine translation task and the GYAFC formal style transfer task.

answer_2.quote: We use widely used evaluation metrics to assess the performance of PEMA as follows: Sacre-Bleu (sBLEU) ... Perplexity (PPL) ... COMET ... Formality Improvement (FormImp).

answer_3.quote: We use pre-trained GPT-2 large to calculate the exponential of the negative log-likelihood of a current token given the previous context.
